title: DND
description: Do Not Disturb sync (capability dnd). dnd-state carries the current phone DND status (phone -> Mac, or bidirectional); dnd-set carries user toggle commands (Mac -> phone). State is event-driven push (ACTION_INTERRUPTION_FILTER_CHANGED broadcast receiver). updated_ms orders states (greater wins, ties keep local). Nonces provide idempotency. Decoders ignore unknown fields.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.12.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

enabled.description: Whether Do Not Disturb mode is active.

updated_ms.description: Unix milliseconds when the state was captured; greater wins (dnd-state only).

has_permission.description: Whether the sender holds the system DND policy access permission (dnd-state only).

origin.description: Which side produced this message; receivers drop echoes of their own origin.
